name: North Wire
old_description: Northwire is committed to being an industry leading designer and manufacturer of custom cable, wire and assemble interconnectivity solutions. We are dedicated to meeting your application needs and regulatory requirements by continuously improving our Quality Management Systems and investing in our workforce.
about:
Northwire Inc. was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Osceola, Wisconsin, with a second manufacturing operation in Santa Teresa, New Mexico. The company designs and manufactures custom technical wire and cable interconnectivity solutions.

Northwire provides vertically integrated cable assembly services including cable preparation, wire termination, connector over-molding, and full cable assembly manufacturing. Its Osceola facility spans 115,250 square feet of manufacturing space and employs 250 people, while the Santa Teresa site adds 48,000 square feet and 50 team members.

The company serves a broad range of industries including medical devices, off-road heavy equipment, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, test and measurement, electronics and machinery, information and networking systems, communications and audiovisual, public sector and automotive, marine and underwater, green energy, and architectural lighting.

Northwire emphasizes its design engineering team, which has over three decades of experience, and offers rapid prototyping and expert guidance on compliance standards. It operates a qualified CSA test facility per ISO 17025:2017 and holds certifications to ISO 9001:2015, AS9100D, and ISO 13485:2016.

name: Northern Bag & Box Co
old_description: Our brand new, state of the art packaging distrubution center is changing the way we do business. The demand for "just-in-time" packaging supplies is on the rise as is our ability to support it. We proudly invite anyone to tour our fantastic facility.
about:
Northern Bag & Box Company was founded in 1926 in Grand Forks, North Dakota, with roots extending across the Red River Valley into Minnesota. The business began as a supplier of industrial and agricultural packaging for the region’s farming and manufacturing base.

Today the company operates a purpose-built, just-in-time packaging distribution center in West Fargo, North Dakota. The facility stocks a comprehensive range of packaging supplies — from bags and boxes to retail-ready commercial items — sourced from domestic and international manufacturers. The company describes its inventory as covering virtually every type of packaging, enabling it to serve customers with rapid turnaround on stocked items.

Northern Bag & Box serves industrial and agricultural producers, as well as retail and commercial accounts whose products reach national store shelves. Its customer base spans nearly every U.S. state plus Mexico and Canada, reflecting a distribution network built over the past 25 years.

The company emphasizes its just-in-time delivery model and a sourcing strategy that combines domestic and global suppliers to keep pace with changing packaging demands. It also highlights a staff with more than 100 years of combined industry experience as a core differentiator.

name: Northlake Medical Supply Inc
old_description: Northlake Medical Supply has been serving the home equipment medical needs of St. Tammany, Washington and Tangipahoa Parish patients, physicians, hospitals and home care agencies with quality healthcare products, equipment and services since 1983.
about:
Northlake Medical Supply was founded in 1983 in Covington, Louisiana, as a family-owned business serving the home medical equipment needs of St. Tammany, Washington, and Tangipahoa parishes. The company operates from its Covington location, supplying durable medical equipment and related services to patients, physicians, hospitals, and home care agencies across the three-parish region.

The company stocks and distributes a broad range of durable medical equipment, including therapeutic wraps and joint products, orthopedic soft goods, bathroom safety aids, lift chairs, scooters, manual and power wheelchairs, and portable and traditional oxygen supplies. Additional product lines cover hospital beds, patient lifts, sleep apnea devices, nebulizers, mastectomy products, and mobility aids such as walkers, canes, and transport chairs. Beyond product supply, Northlake Medical Supply provides patient consultation, equipment fitting, usage instruction, and curb-side service for customers with limited mobility.

The primary customer base consists of home healthcare patients in the three-parish area, along with referring physicians, hospitals, and home care agencies. Typical users include seniors recovering from surgery, individuals with chronic respiratory conditions requiring oxygen or CPAP therapy, and patients needing mobility assistance or orthopedic support. The company also serves caregivers seeking bathroom safety equipment and adaptive aids for home use.

Northlake Medical Supply was founded on the principle that every home healthcare assignment is unique and demands personal, compassionate attention. The family-owned structure emphasizes building trust through long-term relationships, with decisions guided by patient needs. Staff members are noted for providing detailed equipment instruction and consultation, aiming to address both the physical and emotional aspects of home care.

name: Northridge Metal Fabrication LLC
old_description: Since 1965, Northridge Metal (formerly Kaines Of West Michigan) has been producing products from our plants on the shores of beautiful Lake Michigan.  While we have innovative production capabilities and a global customer base, our small town values let us provide service that is uniquely personalized, with response times and quality that are second to none.  This is our foundation and what we have built our reputation upon.
about:
Northridge Metal Fabrication LLC operates from Ludington, Michigan, on the shores of Lake Michigan. The company traces its roots to 1965 when it was founded as Kaines Of West Michigan. In 2022, long-time customer and supplier Design Manufacturing LLC acquired the business and rebranded it Northridge Metal Fabrication LLC, maintaining the existing workforce and structure while adding greater resources. The company remains privately owned.

The shop specializes in precision fabrication of wire and sheet metal products, offering custom design, prototyping, and full-scale manufacturing. Its equipment lineup includes computerized laser cutters, cutoff machines, benders, multislides, presses up to 120 tons, resistance welders up to 400 KVA, and an automated powder coat finishing system. In-house tooling capabilities support new projects and expedited delivery. The facility employs 75 workers and has completed over 3,000 projects.

Customers range from the largest fixture companies and manufacturers to small regional firms. Northridge Metal has worked directly with fixture companies that supply all major retail chains, as well as a wide variety of product manufacturers. Its client base spans the fixture, retail display, and general manufacturing industries worldwide.

The company emphasizes its small-town values, personalized service, and quick response times as key differentiators. Its management team brings over 100 years of combined experience, and the in-house engineering staff works from concept through shipping to deliver solutions tailored to customer needs, budgets, and schedules.

name: Northwest Electric and Solar
old_description: Welcome to Northwest Electric and Solar, your trusted electrical and energy experts in Washington State! As a full-service electrical contractor that specializes in cutting-edge renewable energy technologies for homes and businesses, we’re helping Washingtonians establish a new relationship with their energy. We work closely with every customer to identify your needs and design electrical and energy systems that meet and exceed your goals.
about:
Northwest Electric and Solar is based in Kenmore, Washington, and was founded in 2011 by Master Electrician Derek White. After a decade of commercial and residential electrical experience, White started the company to set a higher standard for renewable energy installations in the Pacific Northwest. The business remains privately held, with White serving as owner and CEO.

The company operates as a full-service electrical contractor and turnkey renewable energy installer. Its core services include custom solar photovoltaic system design and installation, battery energy storage (notably Tesla Powerwall), EV charging station deployment, SPAN smart electrical panel integration, electrical service upgrades, Tesla Solar Roof installation, and Upgen NXG fuel cell backup systems. The firm has completed hundreds of projects across Washington and reports thousands of systems installed. Its Kenmore office doubles as a demonstration site, featuring rooftop solar, on-site EV charging, and real-time energy monitoring.

Northwest Electric and Solar serves residential homeowners, commercial businesses, and builders or community developers throughout Washington State. Examples include home solar and battery retrofits, commercial electrical upgrades for EV infrastructure, and new-construction energy systems for housing developments. The company works closely with local utilities such as Puget Sound Energy to navigate interconnection and incentive programs.

The company emphasizes its NABCEP accreditation — the first in Washington and one of only ten nationwide — and its status as the state's sole Tesla Certified Installer. It differentiates through in-house electrical licensing, which allows a one-stop-shop for complex upgrades, and a culture of continuous training that includes teaching inspectors and utility professionals about emerging technologies like Tesla Powerwall interconnection.

name: Norwood Medical
old_description: Norwood Medical began in 1926 as a tool and die shop. The company worked on tooling for its first medical application in the 1970s. A local businessman who had worked at the company since 1950 purchased the business with a partner in 1981, and by the 1990s, the company had evolved into component manufacturing. Medical component manufacturing and assembly became Norwood’s sole focus in the early 2000s.
about:
Norwood Medical operates from a 700,000-square-foot manufacturing campus in Dayton, Ohio. The company traces its roots to 1926 when it began as a tool and die shop. A local businessman who had worked at the firm since 1950 purchased the business with a partner in 1981, and by the 1990s the operation had evolved into component manufacturing. Medical component manufacturing and assembly became its sole focus in the early 2000s. In 2021, Norwood was acquired by the Heraeus Group, a family-owned German technology group, preserving its family-oriented culture.

The company provides end-to-end contract manufacturing for medical devices, offering more than 30 in-house engineering and production capabilities. Core processes include CNC milling and turning (horizontal, vertical, and 5-axis), CNC Swiss machining, metal injection molding (MIM) with in-house feedstock formulation, insert injection molding, electrical discharge machining (wire and RAM), electrochemical machining (ECM), precision metal stamping, and water-jet cutting. Value-added post-processing covers laser marking and welding, polishing, electropolishing, heat treating, coating (PTFE dry film, sodium stearate, siliconization), ultrasonic cleaning, overmolding, and passivation. Testing, assembly, and packaging are performed in controlled environments supported by nine on-site quality labs. The campus houses over 800 CNC machines and supports production volumes from prototype to full-scale runs, with products used in more than 13 million surgeries annually.

Norwood serves the medical device industry, focusing on cardiovascular, minimally invasive surgery (MIS), orthopedics, robotic-assisted surgery (RAS), and surgical technologies. Its customers include well-known medical device OEMs that rely on the company for complex robotic instruments, energy-sealing devices, and other critical components.

The company emphasizes its vertically integrated model, long-term ownership perspective, and quality mindset as differentiators. It reinvests 3% of revenue annually in automation, maintains a 95% customer retention rate, and operates nine in-house metrology labs equipped with CMM, CT scanning, optical inspection, and laser scanning systems. A dedicated regulatory and compliance department ensures adherence to ISO 13485:2016, FDA 21 CFR 820, and ISO 14971:2019 standards.

old_description: Nucraft Furniture Co. is an office furniture manufacturer based in Comstock Park, Michigan. George W. Schad started the company in Grand Rapids in 1945, first making solid walnut accessories for offices, including coat racks and letter trays. Over the following decades it added occasional tables, bookcases and desks, with much of its early growth coming from US government clients. Its current range covers conference, media and community tables, credenzas, lecterns, benches and private office casegoods, combining woodworking with built-in power and data options. Nucraft also takes custom orders, runs showrooms in Chicago and New York, and holds GSA contracts.
about:
Nucraft Furniture Co. is an office furniture manufacturer headquartered in Comstock Park, Michigan. The company was founded in 1945 by George W. Schad in Grand Rapids, where it began producing solid walnut accessories such as coat racks and letter trays for offices.

Over the decades, the product line expanded to include occasional tables, bookcases, and desks, with early growth driven by U.S. government clients. Today Nucraft offers conference, media, and community tables, credenzas, lecterns, benches, and private office casegoods, combining traditional woodworking with integrated power and data options. The company also accepts custom orders and operates showrooms in Chicago and New York.

Nucraft serves government agencies through GSA contracts and OMNIA agreements, as well as state and local government purchasers. Its furniture is also specified by interior designers and architects for commercial office, education, and collaborative workspaces, with projects ranging from conference rooms to huddle spaces and private offices.

The company emphasizes blending craftsmanship with technology, collaborating with industrial designers to create what it calls "beautiful connections" between interior trends, design expertise, and integrated technology.

name: Nylacarb Corporation
old_description: Since 1987, Nylacarb has been a trusted, family-owned leader in custom plastic injection molding, proudly serving various industies all over the USA from our Vero Beach, FL manufacturing facility. With a steadfast commitment to exceptional communication, precision-crafted components, and reliable on-time delivery, we’ve built lasting partnerships across industries.
about:
Nylacarb Corporation has operated from Vero Beach, Florida since 1987, when the family-owned business established its injection molding facility on the Atlantic coast. The company traces its roots to earlier molding operations in the Northeast before relocating to its current 1725 98th Avenue location, where it now runs as a third-generation manufacturer serving customers nationwide.

The shop specializes in custom plastic injection molding backed by in-house tooling coordination and a full suite of secondary operations. Its capabilities span mold maintenance and repair, drilling, pin setting, overmolding, assembly, EMS shielding, pad printing, and ultrasonic welding, delivering finished components ready for market. An engineering team supports projects from concept through production with CAD design, mold optimization, and product development guidance.

Nylacarb serves a range of sectors including medical devices, water management, and consumer products. References from pH Prescription LLC cite work on the DermaShower system, Dr. Tennant's Bio Transducer, and a Water Management System, illustrating the shop's experience with regulated and precision-driven applications. The company ships parts across the United States.

The business emphasizes communication, on-time delivery, and a "no project too big or too small" philosophy as its operational differentiators. Leadership frames these principles as the foundation for long-term partnerships built over three generations of plastic manufacturing.
